description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {C}{C}.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
 Repeat.
